sq.q: Why is understanding human conduct important?
answer: It is important because it helps individuals make responsible decisions, live ethically, and contribute positively to society and sustainable development.

sq.q: What is meant by human conduct?
answer: Human conduct refers to the way a person lives and behaves, guided by their values, intentions, and understanding of harmony with self, others, and nature.

lq.q: Explain natural acceptance of human values.
answer: Natural acceptance of human values means that the values required for human living are already acceptable to us at the level of the Self. When we understand harmony at different levels, our participation in that harmony becomes our value. In relationship, values such as trust, respect, affection, care, guidance, reverence, glory, gratitude and love lead to mutual happiness. In work with the rest of nature, right utilisation, protection and enrichment lead to prosperity and preservation of nature. These values are not imposed from outside; they are naturally acceptable because every human being wants happiness, prosperity, relationship and harmony. When right understanding develops, value-based living becomes natural and leads to harmony at individual, family, society and nature levels.
